name: Reboot
description: Windows MDM settings in the Reboot category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Daily Recurrent
properties.description: Value in ISO8601, time is required. A reboot will be scheduled each day at the configured time starting at the date and time. Setting a null (empty) date will delete the existing schedule.

properties.name: Single
properties.description: Value in ISO8601 date and time format (such as 2025-10-07T10:35:00) is required. Both the date and time are required. A reboot will be scheduled to occur at the specified date and time. Setting a null (empty) date will delete the existing schedule.

properties.name: Weekly Recurrent
properties.description: Value in ISO8601 date and time format (such as 2025-10-07T10:35:00) is required. While it is supported to set either DailyRecurrent or WeeklyRecurrent schedules, it is not supported to enable both settings simultaneously. A reboot will be scheduled to occur every week at the configured day and time starting at the specified date and time. Setting a null (empty) date will delete the existing schedule.
